notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
You control at least six lands.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken creature.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The face-down Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Tatyova, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental with haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
